```yaml
name: Pre-Checkout Cleanup
on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]
  push:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  pre-checkout-cleanup:
    runs-on: self-hosted
    steps:
      - name: Harden Runner
        uses: step-security/harden-runner@20cf305ff2072d973412fa9b1e3a4f227bda3c76
        with:
          egress-policy: audit

      - name: Checkout Repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
          cache: 'pip'

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install black isort pytest

      - name: Run Pre-Checkout Cleanup Script
        run: |
          # Ensure we have the cleanup script
          if [ ! -f "scripts/fix-runner-permissions.sh" ]; then
            echo "Error: fix-runner-permissions.sh not found"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          # Make script executable
          chmod +x scripts/fix-runner-permissions.sh
          
          # Run the cleanup script
          ./scripts/fix-runner-permissions.sh

      - name: Verify Cleanup
        run: |
          # Check that no dangerous chmod commands were executed
          if grep -r "chmod -R 777" .; then
            echo "Error: Found dangerous chmod commands"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          # Verify proper ownership
          find . -type f -exec ls -l {} \; | grep -E "(root|777)" && echo "Warning: Found potential permission issues" || echo "Permissions look good"

      - name: Run CI Operations
        run: |
          # Run centralized CI operations
          if [ -f "scripts/run-ci.sh" ]; then
            chmod +x scripts/run-ci.sh
            ./scripts/run-ci.sh
          else
            echo "CI script not found, running basic checks"
            python -m black --check .
            python -m isort --check-only .
          fi

      - name: Upload Test Results
        uses: codecov/test-results-action@v1
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          file: tests/test_results.xml
          flags: unittests
```
